name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began in her father's small machine shop in rural Denmark, where she spent her childhood surrounded by the hum of machinery and the smell of oil. Initially drawn to the precision and problem-solving aspects of machining, she soon found herself captivated by the speed and intensity of racing. After completing her apprenticeship, she sought out opportunities to apply her skills in motorsport, landing a role with a local rally team before eventually joining Manthey EMA. 

Astrid is a highly skilled and experienced machinist known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to quickly diagnose and resolve mechanical issues. Her pragmatic approach ensures that solutions are not only effective but also cost-efficient and reliable. She thrives under pressure, maintaining a calm and focused demeanor even in the most demanding situations. Her loyalty to the team and her unwavering commitment to excellence make her an invaluable asset to Manthey EMA.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical braid
physical.description: Astrid has a strong, capable build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an almost dangerous point.
Has a small collection of vintage wrenches she keeps in her toolbox, each with a story.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
